Cutaway: hood and front and rear covers removed. No ND document gives this box's size. Width, height and depth are in the proportion 1 : 2.4 : 3.4 measured off drawing 20066; the absolute size is estimated.
Card counts per half are not in the drawings. Sources: ND-B2C20.pdf; ND-B2C3.pdf sub-chapter 4. Colour: light grey, from the Technostation brochure photograph.
